note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. The decision carries ONLY editable placeholder text; the two labels are neutral labels supplied by the party, of equal weight; a line means only that the party attached that label to that section (as supplied). The substituted datum is which section label A is attached to; neither value is marked as wrong. No grounds catalogue, admissibility, time limit, standard of review, evaluation of any section, outcome or jurisdiction is drawn.
